payload.title: File:Khankhuuluu Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of Khankhuuluu mongoliensis showing known fossil material of the holotype (MPC-D 100/50) and referred (MPC-D 100/51, MPC-D 102/4) specimens scaled to a single silhouette. Both scale bars=1 m.

Note: Several bones mentioned by Perle (1977)—a maxilla fragment, proximal humerus, and manual ungual of the holotype and premaxilla, maxilla, jugal, and dentary of the referred specimen—seem to have been misplaced since then. These bones are tentatively included with gradiented boundaries to indicate preservational uncertainty.

Key

 =Holotype (MPC-D 100/50)
 =Referred (MPC-D 100/51)
 =Referred (MPC-D 102/4)
 =Unknown
